title: periods.boundaries
description: Billing-run boundaries of a subscription at a billing instant: subscription-fee period, usage-charges window, fixed-charges window, durations and neighbouring period edges (BE-SP-12..25). Also holds the plan and subscription objects shared by every periods.* op.

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

current_usage.description: Compute the running period (usage views, progressive billing) instead of the period a periodic run bills.

to_datetime.description: Subscription-fee period end (UTC; local 23:59:59.999999 or the termination).

charges_from_datetime.description: Usage-charges window start; null when not billed this run.

fixed_charges_from_datetime.description: Fixed-charges window start; null when not billed this run.

fixed_charges_period_to_datetime.description: End of the current fixed-charges period even when fixed charges are not billed this run.

period_days.description: Length in days of the whole subscription-fee period (single-day price divisor).

charges_duration_days.description: Length in days of the whole charges period.

next_end_of_period.description: End of the period holding the billing date.

previous_beginning_of_period.description: Start of the period holding the base date.

current_beginning_of_period.description: Start of the period holding the billing date.

pay_in_advance.description: The subscription fee is billed at the start of its period (else at the end).

amount_cents.description: Plan amount per period in minor units.

bill_charges_monthly.description: Yearly/semiannual plans only: usage charges are billed every month.

bill_fixed_charges_monthly.description: Yearly/semiannual plans only: fixed charges are billed every month.

trial_period.description: Trial length in days (decimal; fractions allowed); absent or 0 = no trial.

billing_time.description: calendar: periods follow the calendar; anniversary: periods follow the anchor.

subscription_at.description: Requested start; its local date in `timezone` is the anchor.

started_at.description: Actual start (null for a subscription that never started).

status.x-kit-absent: active, or terminated when terminated_at is given

next_subscription.description: A plan change hanging off this subscription: upgrade = a successor with a higher or equal yearly amount (active when this one is terminated, else pending); downgrade = a pending successor with a lower yearly amount.

created_at.description: Record creation instant (matters for 'started in the past' and periodic selection).

trial_ended_at.description: Set once the trial-end billing ran.

previous_subscription.description: The subscription this one replaced through a plan change (same external id); it is terminated at this subscription's start.

previous_invoice.description: Latest invoice of the subscription (by period end): its time zone snapshot and charge window ends (time-zone continuity rule).
